patterns: One story took over the feed: 36 of 165 hits were about Robert Pattinson as James Bond, and they drew 41,337,169 of the day's 71,081,813 views (58%). DiscussingFilm's plain 'officially cast' post led at 8,531,867.

Tie the big news to something fans already love: 'now officially both Batman and James Bond' did 6,421,962 views and 205,194 likes, the most likes of the day. The 'TWILIGHT predicted it' callback did 3,774,068 with 131,022 likes, and FilmUpdates' filmography list did 2,142,652.

Stack angles on one mega story: first look, poster, teaser, London billboard (1,883,007 views, 141,692 likes, a 7.5% like rate), how and when he was told (612,536), the wiped Bond Instagram (699,477), and co-star reactions (Hunger Games cast 1,105,827, Pugh's text 511,858).
Short nickname captions on reunion photos punch way above their length: FilmUpdates' 'Joshifer has returned.' did 433,659 views with an 8.5% like rate, and the Hunger Games cast reunion did 946,323.

Small accounts ride the wave with BREAKING lines and rankings: CinemaTweets1's 'BREAKING: Pattinson is officially James Bond' did 153,672, and its 'Best Bonds of all time' ranking did 80,739. ATRightMovies won with classic-scene craft (Reeve's Clark Kent-to-Superman shift 85,040; Tarantino on a DUNKIRK shot 42,117).
RottenTomatoes had its best day on the board with a talent reaction video: Pattinson and Villeneuve on the role did 1,034,454.
narrative_synthesis: Bond day: Amazon MGM named Robert Pattinson the next 007, and 36 watchlist posts on it drew 41.3M views (58% of the day). DiscussingFilm's announcement led at 8,531,867, 'both Batman and James Bond' did 6,421,962 with 205,194 likes, and the Hunger Games premiere reunion did 946,323. 168 originals scanned, 165 at 5K+, 161 at 10K+.
